title: Average, but Not Really Impressed…
text:
Average, but Not Really Impressed…. [[VIDEOID:4da8e971fb443393f7ee5a72bee9b6c9]] I was wanting to love this. But, I’m not fond of its low height, cheap particle board, or the back design. All of that out of the way. I was looking for a long stand which this is with LEDs. The LEDs work great and the heavy tempered glass is good. This will take a long time to put together.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)

product_metadata.title: Bestier 70”Modern TV Stand 20 Color RGB Light Entertainment Center, Media Console 6 Storage Glass Shelves, Television Cabinet for TVs up to 75”, for DVDs, Game Devices in The Living Room, Golden Black
features: 【RGB Lighting & 22 Dynamic Modes】The Bestier TV console provides an excellent & immersive viewing or video game experience. The closed storage cabinet can be used to store your personal items. The back wire holes inside the cabinets also help you organize wires and cables.

【Modern Combined with Rustic Style】 This media stand is designed with dimension of 70.8" L*13.6" W*18.3" H. Enjoy happy family moment with such classic modern entertainment center.
